metadata.title: Covariant-FV Laplace-Beltrami, regular global lat-lon N=32x32 (R=1)
metadata.description: Regular global lon-lat sphere, lon in [-pi,pi] periodic, lat in [-pi/2,pi/2], 32x32 cells. Bundles the authored covariant-FV Laplacian rule so build_ode_problem routes through Path A (declarative rule engine) rather than the Path-B PDESystem FD pipeline (esd-6g4.10/G11).
